metadata.goal: Investigate variations in movement characteristics and positioning quality across the provided vehicle trajectories.
metadata.dataset_description: Independently constructed road-aligned WorldTrace case with 214 trajectories.

insight_list.insight: Most vehicle trajectories maintain relatively stable movement and remain closely aligned with their matched-road references.

plot.title: Insight 1
plot.description: A question-specific visualization computed from the synchronized trajectory tables; the case-level overview map is retained separately and is not repeated here.

insight_list.question: What evidence in the trajectories supports this pattern?
insight_list.actionable_insight: Compare relevant groups and inspect exceptions.

insight_list.insight: Turning-intensive routes tend to show less stable speeds and larger point-to-road offsets, especially for smaller vehicles.

insights: Most vehicle trajectories maintain relatively stable movement and remain closely aligned with their matched-road references.
Turning-intensive routes tend to show less stable speeds and larger point-to-road offsets, especially for smaller vehicles.
A few trajectories show extreme acceleration and braking with large point-to-road offsets on otherwise smooth routes.
summary: Most vehicle trajectories maintain relatively stable movement and remain closely aligned with their matched-road references. Turning-intensive routes tend to show less stable speeds and larger point-to-road offsets, especially for smaller vehicles. A few trajectories show extreme acceleration and braking with large point-to-road offsets on otherwise smooth routes.
